mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%, or signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, INDPRO declines do not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a strengthening economy, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with positive GDPC1 growth, or signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending power.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS increases do not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or signal Rank IC < 0.03.
